grades.reason: Rationale for Smepmp PMP rule locking and M-mode memory access prevention. It does not address the outcome of a CSR access that lacks the required privilege.

grades.quote: When an extension’s status is set to Off, any instruction that attempts to read or write the corresponding state will cause an illegal-instruction exception.
grades.reason: It says an access to extension state (FS/VS/XS) whose status is Off raises an illegal-instruction exception. That trigger is a disabled extension, not a privilege violation, so it only loosely hints at the exception type.
Introduction to Smcsrind/Sscsrind indirect CSR access. It says nothing about what happens when a CSR is accessed without sufficient privilege.
Usage guidance for initializing stateen CSRs and granting less-privileged access. It does not state the outcome of an unprivileged CSR access.
